capabilities: Define virtual folder hierarchies using frontmatter parent and children link properties
Browse the abstract hierarchy in tree, column, and group views with drag-and-drop reorganization
Convert between physical folder structures and abstract folder structures in both directions
Sort notes by activity metrics such as hotness, neglect (stale rot), and recursive density
Organize non-Markdown files like images, PDFs, and canvases via parent-defined children lists
disambiguation: It does not create real folders on disk; the hierarchy exists only in frontmatter metadata and a sidebar tree view unless you explicitly run the conversion command.
extras: The README states the plugin works 100% locally with no network requests and recommends BRAT installation for beta versions; the author links an external article, 'The Folders Fail: A PKM Solution', for background.
problem: Standard Obsidian folders are rigid: a file belongs to exactly one folder even when it conceptually belongs to several projects.
summary: Virtual folder system that organizes notes into a hierarchy via frontmatter parent/child links, letting one file live in multiple folders without moving files.
